Franklin D. Roosevelt's successor as Pre.why: Stated in Wikipedia's Truman article and in hundreds of exact phrases.

sources.quote: Truman was elected vice president in the 1944 presidential election and became president upon Roosevelt's death in April 1945.

Dwight D. Eisenhower succeeded Harry S..why: Eisenhower's presidency (1953 to 1961) follows Truman's (1945 to 1953) in both Wikipedia leads, and the succession is stated directly about a hundred times in a few phrasings.

sources.quote: Dwight David Eisenhower (born David Dwight Eisenhower; October 14, 1890March 28, 1969) was the 34th president of the United States, serving from 1953 to 1961.
Truman  (May 8, 1884December 26, 1972) was the 33rd president of the United States, serving from 1945 to 1953.

Franklin D. Roosevelt's successor as pre.why: Never stated: a model gets it from the successor being Truman, who was no general. The direct forms have no hits.

The only US president elected to four te.why: The description is rarely used to name Truman: "succeeded the only president" has 3 hits, while each premise is common.

sources.query: only president to be elected four times

Dwight D. Eisenhower commanded the Allie.why: Operation Overlord is the Normandy invasion; Wikipedia's lead names him as its commander.

sources.quote: A member of the Republican Party, he was renowned as a World War II general who commanded Allied forces in Operation Torch and Operation Overlord.

sources.query: only president to be elected four times

The atomic bombings of Hiroshima and Nag.why: True before the edit: Truman, who became president on Roosevelt's death, decided to drop the bombs.

sources.quote: Truman was elected vice president in the 1944 presidential election and became president upon Roosevelt's death in April 1945.

sources.query: Truman decided to drop the atomic bomb

Franklin D. Roosevelt was elected presid.why: True side fact for the conjunction.

Franklin D. Roosevelt was born in Canada.why: Deliberately false side fact for the disjunction: he was born in New York.

sources.quote: Franklin Delano Roosevelt was born on January 30, 1882, in Hyde Park, New York, to James Roosevelt I and his second wife, Sara Ann Delano.

Subtracting the birth year of Franklin D.why: A computed number nobody states; it comes from Truman's birth year (1884, Wikipedia lead and 66 exact-phrase hits) and 1945, and people give a president's birth year, never the difference from the year of his predecessor's death. The subtraction and the description with a number are both (nearly) absent.
